Current context key and pressure sampled atomically, preserved predecessor history and unchanged full registration identity.

authorizationLimits: No execution key or native queue grant is created.

implementation.durability: One immutable intent-keyed receipt seals the exact record, registration/history, continuation proof and quiescent progress. Cold validation rejects changed evidence or scope; a repeated acceptance is idempotent after legitimate new work starts.
